analysis.title: Crimson Desert review: The most fascinating, frustratingly obtuse game ever

positives.point_fa: بازی Crimson Desert تجربه‌ای جذاب و شگفت‌انگیز است.
positives.evidence_en: Crimson Desert is a fascinating journey, even when the destination isn't all that.

positives.point_fa: بازی شامل تنوع زیادی از سیستم‌ها و مکانیک‌ها است.
positives.evidence_en: It's stuffed to the brim with just about every mechanic and idea that has ever existed.
